description: Gold retrieval evaluation set for the PersonalBrandingAgent knowledge base. Each entry: a query and the source files (paths relative to data/) that a good retrieval strategy should surface. Queries are deliberately varied: semantic, exact terminology, evidence-focused, project-focused, story-focused, metadata-filterable, and broad.

queries.query: What is my preferred LinkedIn writing style and tone?
How should I position myself professionally as a backend AI engineer?
What happened when I implemented Quizey exam versioning?
What evidence supports my database experience with PyMongo and MongoDB?
What lessons did I learn from Kubernetes and typos in my first deployment?
Why should I never trust an LLM's arithmetic?
Which projects demonstrate that I can build AI agents from scratch without frameworks?
What is my experience with CI/CD using Jenkins and GitHub Actions?
How do I test every AI step with a fake LLM?
What certificates have I earned from IBM, Vanderbilt, and Anthropic?
What am I currently learning about RAG and agentic AI?
